Taiki Matsuno ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) }} '''Saturn''' (Japanese: '''サターン''' ''Saturn'') is one of [[Team Galactic]]'s four {{tc|Commander}}s. ==In the core series games== Saturn is first seen leading the efforts of Team Galactic at [[Lake Valor]] near [[Pastoria City]]. He battles the {{player}} inside {{p|Azelf}}'s cave and reveals that [[Mars]] is at [[Lake Verity]]. He is later encountered again in the [[Team Galactic HQ]], overseeing the imprisoned [[lake guardians]] while the [[Red Chain]] is being created. After being defeated again, he allows the player to free the lake guardians. After the events at the [[Spear Pillar]], Saturn can be found in the Galactic Veilstone Building, contemplating what direction to take Team Galactic after [[Cyrus]] disappeared. He was never aware of Cyrus's grander plot and claims to have learned that "extremism is never the solution". In {{g|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}}, Saturn can be found at fought at the {{si|Battle Tower}} during the post-game. ===Pokémon=== ===={{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}}==== =====First battle===== {{Party/end}} ==In the spin-off games== ===[[Pokémon Masters EX]]=== Saturn appears as an [[Non-player character|NPC]] in [[Pokémon Masters EX]] and forms a [[sync pair]] with {{TP|Saturn|Toxicroak}}. He first appears in the [[villain event|villain event prelude]] [[Galactic Nightmare]]. He makes his most significant appearance in the {{DL|Villain arc|Sinnoh: Dreaming in Darkness|Sinnoh villain arc}} of the main story. He also makes a cameo in the [[story event]] [[Shine a Gentle Light]]. Saturn, alongside [[Mars]] and [[Jupiter]], can be battled in the [[extreme battle event]] {{DL|Extreme battle event|Team Galactic Takedown}}. ({{color2|000|Team Galactic HQ}}) |} ==Quotes== {{main|Saturn/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Saturn anime.png|thumb|250px|Saturn in {{aniseries|JN}}]] ====''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''==== Saturn debuted in a cameo at the end of ''[[DP036|A Secret Sphere of Influence!]]''. He, along with some {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s, commented that [[Jessie]], [[James]], and {{MTR}} did a lousy job at stealing the [[Adamant Orb]] for them, and framing [[Nando]] for the crime. Saturn's first speaking appearance was in ''[[DP060|Journey to the Unown!]]'', along with his {{p|Bronzor}}. He managed to steal a cube that was under the guard of the {{p|Unown}} of the [[Solaceon Ruins]] and brought it with him back to the [[Team Galactic HQ]]. Later, in ''[[DP069|Enter Galactic!]]'', Saturn exposed the cube to the meteorites in [[Veilstone City]], transforming it into the [[Spear Key]]. He and a few Team Galactic Grunts went to go steal the meteorites, but ended up meeting {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} for the first time. He also battled {{an|Brock}} and his {{TP|Brock|Croagunk}} with his own {{TP|Saturn|Toxicroak}}, which ended after Team Galactic made a tactical retreat. In ''[[DP096|Losing Its Lustrous]]'' and ''[[DP097|Double Team Turnover!]]'', Saturn stole the [[Adamant Orb]] while it was being transported to the [[Celestic Town Historical Research Center]] from Eterna City. He also aided in stealing the [[Lustrous Orb]] from the [[Celestic Town Historical Research Center]] but was admonished by Cyrus after the completion of the mission for displaying ineptitude. In ''[[DP111|Saving the World From Ruins!]]'', following the failure of [[Mars]]'s [[Iron Island]] mission, [[Cyrus]] placed Saturn in charge of the [[Spear Pillar]]'s excavation from [[Mount Coronet]]. He worked with [[Charon]] to locate ruins on Mount Coronet in ''[[DP136|Gateway to Ruin!]]''. Team Galactic located some ruins, though not the ones they wanted. Saturn and the others then fled following the arrival of [[Looker]] and Ash's group. Later, Saturn returned to Mount Coronet and discovered the Spear Pillar ruins in ''[[DP150|Unlocking the Red Chain of Events!]]'', allowing him to fast-track Team Galactic's scheme. In ''[[DP151|The Needs of the Three!]]'', Saturn kept {{Gary}} at bay while [[J|Pokémon Hunter J]] successfully captured the three {{an|lake guardians}} at [[Lake Valor]]. He later returned to [[Team Galactic HQ]]. In ''[[DP152|The Battle Finale of Legend!]]'', Saturn's Toxicroak was defeated by Brock's Croagunk. After Cyrus passed through the [[dimension]]al portal created by {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}} he realized that Cyrus had just been using him and the other {{tc|Commander}}s to reach his own goals and cared little for those who served him. When Mars hysterically attempted to follow their Leader, Saturn grabbed her arm to block her from doing so, shaking his head solemnly at his fellow Commander. Afterwards he was arrested along with Mars and [[Jupiter]] by [[Looker]] and stated that Team Galactic was finished. He appeared briefly in ''[[DP191|Memories are Made of Bliss!]]'' in {{TRT}}'s fantasy with all the other members of Team Galactic. ====''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''==== Saturn reappeared in ''[[JNS01|The Arceus Chronicles (Part 1)]]'' through ''[[JNS04|The Arceus Chronicles (Part 4)]]'', leading the resurrected Team Galactic in an attempt to bring back Cyrus. As the first step of the operation, he successfully {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{p|Heatran}} in order to power a device meant to open a gate to the world that Cyrus had disappeared into. The operation, however, experienced a setback when the energy cannon exploded and Heatran went on a rampage. Saturn and the other Commanders later faced Ash and his friends in order to stop them from interfering with Team Galactic's plan, but the Commanders were ultimately defeated and captured by {{an|Cynthia}} and placed back under arrest by [[Officer Jenny]], ending their plan in failure. ====Character==== Saturn is determined to successfully complete all his missions and would order a tactical retreat to avoid further complications. As a result of this perfectionist quality of his personality, Saturn tended to call out his {{TP|Saturn|Toxicroak}} to handle interruptions like {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Saturn's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Saturn |pkmn=Bronzor |type1=Steel |type2=Psychic |img=Saturn Bronzor.png |epnum=DP060 |epname=Journey to the Unown! |vajp=Kiyotaka Furushima |vaen=Tom Wayland |desc={{p|Bronzor}} first appeared in ''[[DP060|Journey to the Unown!]]'', where it guided Saturn and his squad through the [[Solaceon Ruins]]. In ''[[DP096|Losing Its Lustrous!]]'', Bronzor proved instrumental in Team Galactic's plan to steal the [[Lustrous Orb]] by putting the security teams guarding it to sleep. It was then defeated in battle by {{an|Cynthia}}'s {{TP|Cynthia|Garchomp}}. Carlo Vázquez ([[DP111]]-[[DP152]], [[JNS01]]-[[JNS04]]) |es_eu=Juan Sainz Maza }} ===Pokémon Generations=== [[File:Saturn PG.png|thumb|250px|Saturn in [[Pokémon Generations]]]] Saturn appeared in ''[[PG11|The New World]]'', in which he was seen watching the events at the [[Spear Pillar]] in [[Team Galactic HQ]]. He was later contacted by [[Cyrus]], who was taken to the [[Distortion World]] by {{p|Giratina}}. Saturn tried to ask him where he was, only to hear Cyrus order him and the rest of [[Team Galactic]] to not go looking for him. After the call was abruptly ended, Saturn told himself that he understood. ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color=7394D5|bordercolor=8bb2ff |ja=山下大輝 ''Daiki Yamashita'' |en=Ricky Ryba |pt_br=Silvio Gonzalez |es_eu=Toni Astigarraga}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Mars Saturn Adventures.png|250px|thumb|Saturn and his Croagunk with Mars and her Purugly in the Pokémon Adventures manga]] ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===== Saturn's role in [[Team Galactic]] is to raise funds for their projects and he has the permission of [[Cyrus]] to use any means he feels necessary; however, he is very lazy and usually sends machines to do his dirty work for him. Saturn decided to kidnap {{adv|Platinum}} for a ransom, as she is the daughter of the wealthiest family in [[Sinnoh]]; however, when his grunts couldn't find a picture of the child he settles on her bodyguards, [[Paka and Uji]]. He eventually tracks them at the [[Lost Tower]] and challenges Paka and Uji to a battle with his {{p|Croagunk}} and {{p|Abra}}. Despite the power his Pokémon possess, they are both defeated by Paka and Uji's skills. Angered by his loss, Saturn throws a temper tantrum and has the grunts seal [[Sinnoh Route 210|Route 210]] which will force them to stop at Veilstone, where their base is located. He is approached by Mars and after a brief argument about her stepping into his room without permission; she transfers energy to the Galactic Bomb. He is later seen at Veilstone where he sets his revenge plan into action which he starts by having the grunts attack Paka and Uji in the darkness of night. After waiting a long time for Paka and Uji to be defeated by the grunts; Saturn's patience wears thin and he pulls out a mysterious machine to use on them. When the grunts finally lure them into firing range Saturn activates the machine; it fires a beam at Paka and Uji which sends them into an unknown dimension where they will stay for all eternity. Having become bored now that he has won; Saturn decides to play video games until [[Cyrus]] enters the room and punishes him for using the machine without permission by pinching his arm. Saturn later appears at [[Lake Valor]] after a period of absence where he plans on blowing up the lake so that he can capture the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Azelf}}. He encounters {{adv|Pearl}} who has come to prevent Team Galactic from blowing up the lake. Saturn easily defeats Pearl and attempts to interrogate him but the countdown for the lakes explosion begins before he can get an answer. Once the lake is blown up Saturn commands the Galactic Grunts to begin the capturing of Azelf. Despite the skills Azelf possesses and Pearl's determination, Saturn eventually ends up the victor and defeats Pearl with a {{m|Gunk Shot}} from his {{p|Octillery}} and successfully captures Azelf. He later arrives at the Team Galactic HQ along with his fellow Commanders Mars and Jupiter where they listen to a speech given by Cyrus; Saturn is seen clapping after he finishes. He later appears at the Spear Pillar where he and his fellow Commanders, Mars and Jupiter await Cyrus's arrival so that he can activate the ritual that will summon {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}}. Saturn is the most shocked of the three when he sees that Cyrus is heavily injured but still promises to let no one stop him from activating the ritual. He, Mars, and Jupiter are all attacked by the Gym Leaders [[Fantina]], [[Roark]], and [[Gardenia]] but despite their challengers neither Commander is afraid. As they battle the Gym Leaders, three more arrive to help them [[Crasher Wake]], [[Maylene]], and [[Candice]] along with [[Byron]] for support; Saturn battles Roark and Fantina while Mars and Jupiter battle the other four. Despite his powerful Pokémon, Saturn is eventually defeated and is trapped underneath a pile of rubble, humorously with his machines airbag crushing him. ====={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===== Later, Saturn and his teammates are discovered by another member of Team Galactic, [[Sird]]. Sird explains to them that she had infiltrated Team Rocket on a mission, but failed. Soon after, they are attacked by [[Riley]] of Iron Island, who had tracked Sird by her Aura. Sird battles Riley, allowing Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars to escape unharmed. Later, Saturn and the other Commanders witness Charon battling Diamond and Pearl in [[Eterna City]] with {{p|Heatran}} and {{p|Giratina}}. Despite their irritation that Charon has revealed his true loyalties, they decide to ignore it so that they can enter the Distortion World and rescue Cyrus. After arriving, they find Charon there as well. He lies and tells them that he is searching for Cyrus too, but is being attacked by a group of people and asks for their help. Saturn and the others comply, and they each face a different opponent in a one-on-one battle. Saturn faces [[Mira]] in battle, while Jupiter faces [[Marley]], and Mars faces [[Cheryl]]. During the battle, Saturn is confused at Mira's battle strategy which has her make her Alakazam boost its defensive power in an attempt to make the battle longer. The battle is interrupted by Giratina, who flies past them so that it can fight the other Legendary Pokémon in the area. After Charon is defeated, Saturn, his fellow Commanders, and Cyrus emerge from the Distortion World and into the real world. Charon tries to lie to Cyrus by claiming that he intended to gather the Legendary Pokémon for Team Galactic's sake. Cyrus reaches down to Charon, which Saturn and Mars think it means he's going to pinch him. However, Cyrus only takes his machine, and praises Charon for his technological genius. The records reveal that he has been using it since the battle on the Spear Pillar, which angers Saturn into figuring out that he was attempting to use the machine to control Dialga and Palkia into opening a hole to the Distortion World, to which Charon denies. Cyrus speaks to his four Commanders once more and reveals that he is disbanding Team Galactic, which angers Jupiter because she, Saturn, and Mars will have nowhere else to go without him. Hearing her wishes, Cyrus takes Saturn, Mars, and Jupiter away with him and thanks Diamond, Pearl, Platinum for their help. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Toxicroak 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Saturn |main=yes |pkmn=Toxicroak |stage1=Croagunk |gender=female |type1=Poison |type2=Fighting |img=Saturn Toxicroak Adventures.png |img_size=120px |epnum=PS349 |epname=Passing by Probopass and Maneuvering around Magnezone |desc={{p|Toxicroak}} is Saturn's first known Pokémon. Octillery's known moves are {{m|Octazooka}}, {{m|Gunk Shot}}, and {{m|Blizzard}}.}} ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== [[File:Saturn DPA.png|thumb|170px|Saturn in the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga]] Saturn first appeared in the ruins of [[Celestic Town]] along with [[Jupiter]] and [[Cyrus]]. However, any relationship between them, if any, is unknown. * Saturn was incorrectly referred to as female on multiple occasions outside of the {{pkmn|games}}. He was identified as female in one mistranslated chapter of [[Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]] and then again on [[Pokémon Sunday]]. The confusion is also furthered by his feminine Japanese voice. ** It should also be noted that Saturn is one of the few Trainers in the main series games not encountered in the {{Gdis|Battle Frontier|IV}} to have a Pokémon with a 50-50 chance of being male or female to be the opposite gender as himself, along with [[Bugsy]], [[Will]], [[Janine]] (Generation II) and [[Grimsley]].
